org.name: Budget Ndio Story
org.tagline: Making Kenya's budget transparent and accessible

team.name: Millicent Makina
team.description: Guiding our governance and ensuring our mission aligns with long-term civic impact goals.
team.bio: Millicent is a distinguished governance advisor with extensive experience guiding non-profit boards, international development initiatives, and public interest institutions. She ensures BNS operates with uncompromised integrity, sustainable oversight, and strategic clarity.
team.profileText:
Millicent Makina serves as Board Advisor to Budget Ndio Story, bringing decades of institutional leadership, legal-compliance oversight, and public governance mastery. She works closely with executive leadership to evaluate organizational impact, navigate regulatory landscapes, and anchor BNS's vision in sustainable civic transformation.

Her background spans public sector governance reform, civil society capacity building, and financial stewardship. Millicent's strategic counsel ensures BNS remains a trusted, non-partisan authority in Kenya's public finance ecosystem.
achievements: Formulated BNS's inaugural 5-year Strategic Governance & Accountability Framework.
Guided organizational transition into a multi-entity civic-tech consortium.
Spearheaded board-level ethics and transparency standards for public interest reporting.
team.quote: Strong institutions are built when transparent oversight becomes a shared civic habit.

team.name: James Maingi Mutinda
team.description: Connecting BNS with global and local partners to scale our institutional legacy and democratic stability.
team.bio: Drives BNS's strategic coalitions, international development partnerships, and institutional growth. James bridges youth-led movements with policy research institutions, civil society orgs, and donor partners.
team.profileText:
James Maingi Mutinda is Director Partnerships at Budget Ndio Story, responsible for expanding BNS's institutional footprint, strategic alliances, and sustainability networks. He brings extensive experience in stakeholder management, public interest advocacy, and inter-organizational diplomacy.

James leads engagement with key consortium partners—including academic bodies, legal advocacy groups, and grassroots coalitions—to scale BNS's reach into secondary schools, universities, and community halls across Kenya.
achievements: Secured founding partner coalitions with Colour Twist Media, The Continental Pot, and TISA Kenya.
Expanded BNS civic workshops to over 25 university campuses nationwide.
Structured strategic Terms of Reference (ToR) for national fiscal literacy dialogues.
team.quote: Lasting democratic progress happens when diverse partners unite around shared transparency.

team.name: Movine Omondi
team.description: 10+ years in public policy and youth advocacy. Former advisor to key civic bodies, leading our holistic strategy.
team.bio: With over a decade of experience in public policy and youth advocacy, Movine has been at the forefront of transforming how young Kenyans engage with fiscal governance. As Executive Director, she provides strategic leadership across all BNS programs and partnerships.
team.tagline: Strategic Policy Leader & Youth Fiscal Advocate
team.profileText:
Movine Omondi is a seasoned public policy expert and civic strategist who has spent the last 10+ years at the nexus of youth empowerment, legislative oversight, and democratic governance. As Executive Director of Budget Ndio Story (BNS), she steers the strategic vision, institutional partnerships, and multi-channel advocacy campaigns that demystify the national budget for millions of young citizens.

Her work centers on turning complex economic indicators, debt policy, and parliamentary budget votes into actionable civic knowledge. Under her leadership, BNS has expanded into a national consortium uniting media houses, policy think tanks, and campus budget chapters.
achievements: Pioneered the BNS National Youth Budget Literacy Campaign reaching 1.2M+ young Kenyans.
Advised parliamentary committees on youth-inclusive fiscal public participation.
Established chapter-based budget tracking networks across 47 Kenyan counties.
team.quote: Public finance is not just numbers; it is the ultimate expression of a nation's priorities and values.

team.name: Shem Odhiambo Ojunga
team.description: Award-winning digital strategist specializing in viral civic content that meets youth where they are.
team.bio: Shem is an award-winning digital strategist who has shaped how civic content goes viral in Kenya. As Director of Media, he oversees all content production across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and podcasts.
team.profileText:
Shem Odhiambo Ojunga is the creative engine behind Budget Ndio Story's media strategy. As Director Media, he oversees short-form digital production, video documentaries, graphics, and multi-platform distribution across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and X.

With a track record of driving viral civic engagement, Shem pioneered the art of breaking down parliamentary tax debates, budget allocations, and inflation trends into high-energy, relatable digital assets. His work has fundamentally changed how young citizens consume and debate public finance.
achievements: Produced digital video campaigns generating over 1.2M+ organic views.
Awarded top civic digital communicator for Finance Bill youth engagement.
Established BNS's high-capacity multimedia studio and content pipeline.
team.quote: If civic education isn't engaging, citizens will disengage. We make truth unmissable.

team.name: Peculiar Koros
team.description: Heads the IT department, driving BNS's technology infrastructure and digital innovation to power transparent civic engagement.
team.bio: Peculiar leads BNS's IT department, overseeing the technology infrastructure and digital systems that power the organisation's platforms and data pipelines. He drives innovation that keeps BNS at the forefront of civic-tech in Kenya.
team.profileText:
Peculiar Koros leads the technological architecture and digital strategy of Budget Ndio Story. Combining computer science expertise with rigorous research methodologies, he designs the data pipelines, web platforms, and automated analysis tools that power BNS's real-time budget verification systems.

Recognized for maintaining a 100% clean audit record in fiscal research, Peculiar ensures that every metric, infograph, and tracker published by BNS is verified against primary government datasets, national treasury publications, and parliamentary reports.
focusAreas: Open Data Architecture & Public Finance APIs
achievements: Architected the BNS Headless CMS & Interactive Fiscal Explorer platform.
Developed automated verification routines cross-referencing Finance Bill line items with Appropriation Acts.
Maintained 100% data audit accuracy across 500+ published civic budget tools.
team.quote: Data without integrity is noise; verified data with clarity is power.

team.name: Nelly Maina
team.description: The voice of 'Budget Mtaani', breaking down complex fiscal policies into relatable street slang.
team.bio: Nelly is the charismatic voice behind Budget Mtaani podcast, translating complex fiscal policies into relatable street slang. Her episodes consistently rank among top podcasts in civic education.
team.tagline: Voice of 'Budget Mtaani' & Youth Content Host
team.profileText:
Nelly Maina is a dynamic broadcaster and community storyteller who serves as Lead Podcast Host at Budget Ndio Story. As the anchor of 'Budget Mtaani' (Budget in the Streets), she brings public finance down to earth for youth listeners in Nairobi and across Kenya.

Nelly's signature style blends humor, street-smart commentary, and sharp policy questions. She regularly interviews economists, market vendors, students, and policymakers, creating an inclusive forum where everyday citizens can understand how budget decisions impact their daily cost of living.
achievements: Hosted over 50+ episodes of 'Budget Mtaani' ranking in the top 5 Kenyan civic podcasts.
Featured on national radio panels discussing youth views on tax legislation.
Built an interactive listener community contributing real-time budget questions.
team.quote: When budget talk moves from parliament to the mtaani, real accountability begins.
